heroSummary: All District 196 students start Monday, August 31, 2026. There is no school Friday, September 4 or Monday, September 7, creating a four-day Labor Day weekend. MEA Break is October 15–16, Winter Break runs December 23–January 1, Spring Break runs March 29–April 2, and the last student day is June 9, 2027. Most schools use trimesters; Eastview High School uses quarters.

calendarNotes: This page covers District 196’s districtwide 2026–27 academic calendar. No-school dates may be districtwide or apply only to K–8 or grades 9–12, so families should check the scope printed for each date. Most schools use trimesters; Eastview High School uses quarters. School-specific events, activities, and fine-arts dates are maintained on each school’s calendar.

customSections.label: What Changed for 2026–27
customSections.content: Two changes stand out in the 2026–27 calendar.

groups.label: Changes families may notice
items: All students start together August 31. District 196 removed the two elementary assessment days previously used during opening week.
Students have three additional school days because the district completed required READ Act training ahead of schedule.

customSections.label: Translation Note: Differences in the Somali Calendar
customSections.content: The approved English calendar and Spanish translation list Trimester 2 as November 30–March 4 and January 22 as a K–12 no-school day. The Somali PDF lists the trimester start as 11/20 and labels January 22 as 9–12. When the translated PDFs differ, this page uses the approved English calendar as the source of record.

calendarFaqs.q: When does District 196 start school in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: All students start Monday, August 31, 2026. The approved calendar does not print separate first days by grade.

calendarFaqs.q: When is District 196 MEA break in 2026?
calendarFaqs.a: MEA Break is a districtwide no-school period on Thursday and Friday, October 15–16, 2026.

calendarFaqs.q: When is District 196 Winter Break in 2026-27?
calendarFaqs.a: Winter Break runs December 23, 2026, through January 1, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: When is District 196 Spring Break in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: Spring Break runs March 29 through April 2, 2027.

calendarFaqs.q: Which District 196 conference days are no-school days?
calendarFaqs.a: October 9 applies to grades 9–12. November 5 and February 4 apply to K–8. November 6, January 22, and February 5 are districtwide no-school days.

calendarFaqs.q: When is the last day of District 196 school in 2027?
calendarFaqs.a: The last student day is Wednesday, June 9, 2027. June 10 is a teacher grading day after the last student day.

calendarFaqs.q: Does Eastview High School use District 196 trimesters?
calendarFaqs.a: No. Eastview High School uses four quarters with dates printed separately from the district's three general trimesters.
